title: Philip K. Dick — a declared absence: the novels, the late trilogy and the Exegesis named, with the stories already open
edition: No edition held. The seat holds the declaration of what it would hold: declared/absence.json and declared/absence.md.

why_seated: MANUS, 27 October 2026, after the twenty-seventh seating entered Deleuze and Guattari as a declared absence: "and a declared absence/ wanted seating: hypatia, d & g, pkd, allen ginsberg, anne carson, and tao lin - including the mandalas. and paul klee. too many files and too many image copyright landmines." Philip K. Dick (1928–1982) is entered as wanted. His novels and the Exegesis are in copyright: the works published before 1978 run ninety-five years from publication, those after it seventy years from his death, to 1 January 2053.
ruling: A declared absence, the wanted seating: the works named, with their rights and opening dates, and no text (MANUS, 2026-10-27).
